input.summary: Delete the Customer-only 18-month non-solicit/no-engage covenant in § 12.4.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted § 12.4: it binds only us, runs 18 months, reaches every Silverline employee at any time during the term, bars engagement as well as solicitation, and has no general-advertising carve-out — and it contradicts § 12.3, under which we give no no-hire commitment. Our position is no non-solicit on the customer; if you need one, we can accept a mutual 12-month covenant limited to personnel directly involved in the Services with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no hiring prohibition.
